main_text.head: Illustrissimis, Amplissimis, ac præpotentibus Dominis Ordinibus Confœderatarum Belgii provinciarum, nec non Excellentissimo invictissimoque HEROI MAVRITIO D. G. PRINCIPI Arausionensium, Comiti Nassaviæ, &c. summo per fœderatum Belgium terra marique militiæ duci,
main_text.p:
Se atque sua dicat sacratque
Bartholomeus vander Bild.

page.notes: The title is set in mixed italic and roman type with large capitals for HEROI, MAVRITIO, D. G., PRINCIPI. The first line is set in italic with long-s forms rendered as plain s. The line "Se atque sua dicat sacratque" is italic and "vander" is italic within a roman signature line. The page is a dedication, not a running text; no page number or catchword is printed.
